props.heading: The Living Philosophy of the Studio
props.subheading: Dismantling the artificial divide between scientific rigor and aesthetic wonder.
props.col1: I began my scholarly life in sterile university chemistry laboratories, surrounded by fume hoods, NMR spectrometers, and high-performance liquid chromatography columns. Yet my heart was always pulled toward the smell of crushed madder roots, the bubbling warmth of fermentation vats, and the tactile weave of handspun linen.
props.col2: Natural dyes are not merely historical relics or primitive substitutes for synthetic colorants; they are complex living systems governed by thermodynamics, coordination chemistry, and biodiversity. When we investigate them with scientific rigor, we honor millennia of empirical wisdom.
props.caption: FIG. 2: Botanical ledger specimen and field notes

props.quote: When an indigo vat breathes, billions of anaerobic bacteria reduce insoluble indigotin into liquid gold. The dyer's hand is simply an instrument of that living ecology.
props.author: Dr. E. Archer
